cover_subtitle: Build a YouTube transcript flow in 3 days, even if you’re a beginner.

slides.title: Step 1 – Get the Key
slides.body: Sign in to Google Cloud → Create a project → Enable YouTube Data API v3 → Generate an API key. Copy the key.

slides.title: Step 2 – Pull Video Info
slides.body: Use requests in Python → GET https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos?part=id,snippet&id=VIDEO_ID&key=API_KEY → Extract video ID and title.

slides.title: Step 3 – Fetch the Transcript
slides.body: Call https://video.google.com/timedtext?lang=en&v=VIDEO_ID → Parse XML → Convert to JSON → Pass to Claude for summarisation.

slides.title: Step 4 – Store & Auth
slides.body: Save transcript JSON in Firestore → Add Firebase Auth → Create sign‑up/login pages → Track transcript count per user.

slides.title: What’s Next
slides.body: Add rate‑limit handling → Improve Claude prompt → Launch a beta to early users.

last_slide: Follow for weekly posts on building with AI from scratch.
